title: Oscar and the Group Chat
author: C. M. Yarrow
blurb: Hazel Kavanagh, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
